title: Seattle Shield Business & Occupation (B&O) Tax Changes
issuer: City of Seattle, Office of City Finance

passages.question: Is HANGS General Contracting over the 2026 $2 million threshold?
passages.excerpt: The B&O tax threshold will increase from $100,000 to $2 million. ... Businesses with taxable revenue of $2 million or more will be over the threshold and will be able to deduct up to $2 million of standard deduction per calendar year from their taxable revenue to arrive at their taxable amount.
